sentences.en: It's hard for me to always be in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 1. 我总是处在聚光灯下是很困难的。

sentences.en: Sami is finally having his moment in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 2. 萨米终于迎来了他闪耀的时刻。

sentences.en: When will I get my chance in the spotlight?
sentences.zh: 3. 我什么时候才能轮到我站在聚光灯下的机会呢？

phrases.zh: 处于聚光灯下，受到关注。

senses.zh: 聚光灯(的光)公众注意的中心
聚光照明使公众注意, 使突出醒目
